That trace is pointing pretty hard at two hot spots: repeated `pack_full_generation` work and `flush_main` writes inside `process_checkpoints`. I’ll follow those names through the migration path first, then we can make the smallest change that cuts repeated Git/object work instead of just sprinkling timers.

input.cmd: rg -n "checkpoints v2|checkpoint v2|v2" cmd/entire/cli/strategy cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint cmd/entire/cli -g '*.go'

content.text: I found the migration implementation in `cmd/entire/cli/migrate.go`, and the timings already look instrumented around the suspected costly calls. I’m also checking whether this repo has the requested `go:discover-related` helper wired up before I touch Go code, since the local instructions call that out.

input.cmd: rg -n "discover-related|go:discover|dup:|checkpoints_version|migrate --checkpoints" .mise.toml mise.toml Makefile Taskfile.yml .github cmd docs AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md

content.text: The repo has the `go:discover-related` instruction in `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`, but I don’t see an actual task or skill with that name registered here. I’m doing the equivalent manually by reading the v2 writer, generation helpers, and existing migration tests before editing.

The current migration already batches `/main` but it still flushes once per `/full` generation, and the generation size is the normal runtime threshold of 100 checkpoints. Your trace has 24 archive packs plus 25 `/main` flushes, so even modest per-pack fixed cost becomes minutes. I’m checking whether we can safely decouple migration’s archive batch size from the runtime rotation threshold.

input.cmd: rg -n "func \(s \*GitStore\) getFetchingTree|func WalkCheckpointShards|type FetchingTree|func \(.*\) Tree\(" cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint -g '*.go'

content.text: I’m going to make two scoped changes: cache the initial v2 checkpoint set so fresh checkpoints don’t do a `/main` tree lookup one-by-one, and raise the migration archive batch size while keeping `/full/current` under the normal runtime threshold. That should directly reduce the repeated `flush_main` and `pack_full_generation` bursts in your trace without changing the v2 read format.

*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/migrate.go
@@
-var migrateMaxCheckpointsPerGeneration = checkpoint.DefaultMaxCheckpointsPerGeneration
+const migrateDefaultCheckpointsPerGeneration = checkpoint.DefaultMaxCheckpointsPerGeneration * 5
+
+// migrateMaxCheckpointsPerGeneration controls how many checkpoints migration
+// packs into one archived /full/<n> ref. It intentionally exceeds the runtime
+// /full/current rotation threshold: migration writes immutable archives in
+// bulk, while /full/current is still kept at the normal v2 size.
+var migrateMaxCheckpointsPerGeneration = migrateDefaultCheckpointsPerGeneration
*** End Patch

content.text:
Implemented a migration speedup in [migrate.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/migrate.go:249):

- Migration now packs archived `/full/<n>` refs in batches of 500 instead of 100, so your 24 `pack_full_generation` bursts should become about 5 for the same checkpoint volume.
- `/full/current` still rotates at the normal 100-checkpoint runtime threshold, so normal v2 behavior stays bounded after migration.
- Added a one-time v2 checkpoint ID index, avoiding repeated `/main` lookups for every fresh v1 checkpoint.
- Added a guard test in [migrate_test.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/migrate_test.go:68).

Verified with:

```bash
go test ./cmd/entire/cli -run 'TestMigrateFullBatchSize|TestMigrateCheckpointsV2|TestMigrateFull|TestUpdateV2FullCurrentRef|TestPruneV2CheckpointForForce|TestMigrateCmd' -count=1
go test ./cmd/entire/cli ./cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint -count=1
mise run lint
```

Only `cmd/entire/cli/migrate.go` and `cmd/entire/cli/migrate_test.go` were changed; existing untracked files were left alone.
